# The skips the browser suite held when this ratchet landed (10.10.2026), and
# what is left of them.
#
# One line each: "<file>:<line><tab><call as written, on one line>". The line
# number is informational; the call text is what gets matched.
#
# This list may only shrink. On 10.10 it held eighty entries; all eighty were
# classified the same day, so it holds none. A skip comes off it by saying
# which kind of skip it is, the way the Go suite does:
#
#   test.skip(cond, absent("..."))
#   test.skip(cond, notApplicable("agent-arch", "..."))
#   test.skip(cond, waived("WV-2026-004", "2026-12-31", "<evidence>", "..."))
#
# An entry here with nothing left to match is itself a failure, so the list
# cannot rot into a rubber stamp. It is kept empty rather than deleted: the
# ratchet reads it, and a missing file would be a different failure that says
# something else.
